name: Aimia Inc.
source: Audited consolidated statements of operations, Aimia Inc. annual financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, CAD millions scaled to units. Revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit, and profit before tax less income tax equals net earnings, in both columns. Earlier years are not carried because the previous source could not be reproduced against an audited statement.

rows.label: Revenue
rows.note: Revenue from contracts with customers, consolidated statements of operations, years ended 31 December 2025 and 2024, CAD millions scaled to units

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.note: Selling, general and administrative expenses plus the impairment charge, both as printed

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.note: Operating income or loss as printed

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.note: Reconciling figure between operating income and profit before tax: financial expenses net of 41.8 less interest, dividend and other investment income of 7.7 less share of equity accounted earnings of 0.4 less net change in fair value of investments of 0.1 less carried interest and warrant gain of 9.2. FY2024: financial expenses 17.3 less interest income 9.7 plus equity accounted losses 6.9 plus investment fair value loss 16.5 less carried interest gain 10.1

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.note: Earnings or loss before income taxes as printed

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.note: Income tax expense as printed: current 12.5 less deferred recovery 4.7 for FY2025, and current 16.7 less deferred recovery 7.1 for FY2024

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.note: Net earnings or loss as printed. Profit before tax less income tax reproduces this row exactly in both years

rows.label: EPS
rows.note: withheld: the printed earnings per share line of 0.38 for FY2025 and negative 0.75 for FY2024 does not reconcile with net earnings attributable to equity holders of negative 16.2 million on 92,446,746 weighted shares, so the figure is not reproducible from the audited statement and is left empty rather than carried

mergedSources: Aimia audited annual financial statements FY2025
